comment: Save-and-restore variation of nested-subroom-skipped-slot-overview: restore.c dorecover() reads the hero's level through getlev() -> mkroom.c rest_rooms(). Seed 5311035's Dlvl 1 has themerms.lua 'Nesting rooms' (344-373): outer room (33,7)-(44,17), its subroom S (33,9)-(39,15) in gs.subrooms[0] and S's own subroom T (35,12)-(35,15) in gs.subrooms[1] (port-only scanSeeds() probe over 5310001-5311035 for a Dlvl 1 subroom with nsubrooms > 0, third of 3 hits). mkroom.c rest_room() (875-886) reads T over S in slot 0 and skips slot 1, which every getlev() finds zeroed (save.c:560-564 memset of svr.rooms[], which holds gs.subrooms[]: decl.h:1203, decl.c:1169); T's squares keep slot 1's room number, so u.urooms names that zero slot when the hero stands in T, and dungeon.c recalc_mapseen() (3136-3144) reads svr.rooms[ridx].rtype for it. The debug-mode Samurai level-teleports to Dlvl 2 and back, teleports to (35,13) inside T and saves; the second segment restores, declines to keep the save file, runs #overview, dismisses it and searches. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session and batch game.
